bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
if ! mountpoint -q /mnt/g; then echo G_UNMOUNTED; exit 21; fi
units="$(systemctl --user list-units --all --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'collect|download|archive' || true)"
if [ -z "$units" ]; then
 if ps -eo args | grep -Ei '[p]ython.*(collect|download|archive)' >/dev/null; then echo COLLECTOR_PROCESS_FOUND; exit 31; fi
 echo NO_COLLECTOR_UNIT_OR_PROCESS; exit 32
fi
active="$(printf '%s\n' "$units" | grep -E ' active running ' | wc -l)"
if [ "$active" -gt 0 ]; then echo COLLECTOR_UNIT_ACTIVE; exit 33; fi
echo COLLECTOR_UNITS_PRESENT_INACTIVE
exit 34
